_meta_itemized.notes: HEAVY, FOGGED SCAN (index text_quality 'low'; the page is dark from edge to edge and the handwriting is large and over-inked) - the worst-legibility filing in this chunk, and the reason for 9 escalation crops. GEOMETRY IS DECLARED, NOT MEASURED, ON BOTH PAGES: rowbands finds NO rules at all in the upper half of either page (p2 returns 12 bands, all below y=63%; p3 returns 27 bands, all below y=48%), because the fog swallows the printed rules where the data actually is. The frames declared here are fitted to the page's OWN surviving rules and then verified by cropping every band that carries a row: p2 pitch 1.81 / y0 19.15 (fitgrid on p2 reports pitch 1.8483 explaining 13 of 15 detected rules; a direct dark-row probe of the 15-45% window gives a regular run at 26.15, 28.02, 29.74, 31.56, 33.46, 35.26, 37.06, 38.76, 40.60, 42.40, 44.26 - mean spacing 1.81 - which extrapolates up to a table-top rule at 19.1, matching the visible grid); p3 y0 36.55 with pitch 3.20, which is the WRITTEN-ROW pitch, not the printed-band pitch - on p3 each handwritten row occupies one tall band followed by a thin empty one, so band 1/2/3 of the declared frame are the three written rows and each declared box was crop-verified to contain its row. Both frames carry force_declared so no row can silently resolve against the junk bands detected lower down the page. A SOURCE PROPERTY WORTH RECORDING: on the p3 expense sheet the filer SWAPPED the 'Person or Organization' and 'Purpose of Expenditure' columns on two of three rows - line 1 has 'Filing fees' in the payee column and 'Summit County' in the purpose column, line 3 has 'Travel/fuel' as payee and 'Chevron' as purpose, while line 2 is in the intended order. The columns themselves are unambiguous (printed headers, printed rules), so this is the FILER's transposition, not a field shift in the read: the cells are transcribed by COLUMN POSITION exactly as printed and the swap is flagged per row rather than silently corrected. The candidate is indexed as 'Franchek' and the portal also renders him 'Frendelc'; the ledger's own handwriting reads Michael Franchek. NO CITY IS INFERRED: the p2 donor row's Mailing Address cell holds a street address with no city or state written after it (the sheet's separate Zip Code cell is filled), so donor_city/donor_state are honestly BLANK - and this filing is NOT redacted, the address simply was not completed with a city.
